headline: Air National Guard Pararescuemen Save Injured Fisherman 700 Miles at Sea

body:
Four California Air National Guard pararescuemen parachuted into the Pacific Ocean to rescue a badly injured fisherman located 700 nautical miles from Cabo San Lucas.

The team swam to the fisherman's boat and provided overnight medical care, demonstrating the kind of swift, coordinated response that can mean the difference between life and death in remote ocean emergencies. The distance—700 nautical miles—underscores just how far from help this fisherman had been, making the rescue all the more remarkable.

This operation showcases the training and dedication of air rescue personnel who stand ready to respond to emergencies, no matter how remote or challenging the location.

Pararescuemen parachuted into the Pacific Ocean
